performance_intent: Adds always-inline attributes to five existing conversion entry points without changing their bodies
checked_scope: from_chars_advanced<uint64_t,char> at default base ten on exactly eight arbitrary bytes with a ninth sentinel, initial output 123; error, consumed position, and value at the x86-64 LLVM IR level
checker: Alive2 old-to-new and new-to-old for error and value; exact normalized LLVM IR identity check for all three integer outputs and their callee/constants

result.integer_error_and_value: Alive2 proves both directions for each field (4/4 checks)
result.integer_consumed: Alive2 times out in both directions; the two complete integer IR call graphs are textually identical after normalizing equivalent metadata references, including all three wrappers, their inlined parser callee, and four lookup constants
result.floating_point: Alive2 cannot translate the volatile float load in rounds_to_nearest when comparing target_double_error

limitations: Local integer-path LLVM result only. The floating-point conversion paths, other types/lengths/options, target ISAs, and whole-commit semantics are not proved by Alive2. No official historical before/after benchmark score measured.
